checklist.item: Joint width and the design movement (open, closed, shear) are stated and match the structural drawings.
checklist.why: A cover sized without the movement tears or jams.

checklist.item: The water barrier, air barrier and roof membrane cross the joint with a flexible bellows or pre-formed seal, continuous at changes of plane.
checklist.why: Joints leak at corners and transitions, not on the straight run.

checklist.item: Fire-rated assemblies have a rated joint system across the gap with the same rating.
checklist.why: An open joint in a rated floor or wall is a breach.

checklist.item: Insulation is continuous across the joint with compressible fill.
checklist.why: The joint is otherwise a full-height thermal gap.

checklist.item: Cover plate fixing is to one side only, or as the product requires, so it can move.
checklist.why: A cover fixed both sides buckles.

checklist.item: Floor covers are flush and meet accessibility limits for level change and gaps.
checklist.why: Raised covers trip and fail accessibility.
